paite: Persia kumpipa Kura kum thumna kumin Danial, a min Beltesazar kiangah thu khat a hongkihilha; huan huai thu tuh a tak ahi a, kidouna thupi mahmah; huchiin huai thu a theisiama, mengmuhna theihsiamna a nei hi.
english: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, even a great warfare: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

paite: Huai laiin kei Danialin nipikal pumpi kal thum ka sun a.
english: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.

paite: Tanghou lim ka ne kei a; sa hiin uain hileh ka kam ah a lut keia; sathau leng, nipikal pumpi thum a tunkum masiah, ka nilh het kei hi.
english: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine into my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.

paite: Huan kha masapen ni sawmnih leh li niin, lui lian, Hiddekel pangah ka nadinga
english: In the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel,

paite: Ka daka, huan ngaiin, mi khat puan malngat silh, a kawngte Uphazi dangkaeng sianga gak ka mu a;
english: I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold, a man clothed in linen, whose thighs were adorned with pure gold of Uphaz:

paite: A pumpi leng beril-suang bang ahi a; a mai khophia kilatdan bang ahi; a mitte meisel kuang bang, a bante leh a khepekte a jia dal nawttet bang; a thugen ging mipi aw bang ahi;
english: his body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches, and his arms and his feet like burnished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

paite: Huchiin kei Danial kiain mengmuhna ka mu hi; ka kianga om miten lah huai mengmuhna a mu ngal kei ua; himahleh a tunguah nakpia linna a hong tunga, bu dingin a taikekta uhi
english: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision; but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.

paite: Huchiin kei kiaa nutsiatin ka oma; huan hiai mengmuhna thupi ka muta hi; huchiin keiah hatna a om nawnta keia; ka kilawmna keiah siatna a hongsuak taa; hatna keplai ka neita kei hi.
english: So I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me; for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

paite: Hina piin a thute aw ka jaa; a thute aw ka jak laiin, a khupin nakpi takin ka ihmutaa, ka mai lei lam ngain.
english: Yet heard I the voice of his words; and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I fallen into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.

paite: Huan, ngaiin, khutin a hon khoiha; ka khuk leh ka khut pekte tungah hon lungsaka.
english: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.

paite: Huan aman ka kiangah, Aw Danial, nang nakpitaka ita ompa, na kianga ka thugente theisiam inla, ding tangin; na kianga tua sawl lah ka hi ngala; a chi a; Huan hiai thu ka kianga a gen laiin, ling kawmin ka dingta hi.
english: He said to me, Daniel, you man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright; for am I now sent to you. When he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.

paite: Huan aman ka kiangah, Lau ken, Danial, theisiam ding leh na Pathian maa kiniamkhiak dinga, na lungtang na koihkip ni masapen akipan, na thute jakin a om hi; huan na thute jiaka hong ka hi.
english: Then he said to me, Don’t be afraid, Daniel; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard: and I have come for your words’ sake.

paite: Himahleh Persia gam lalpan ni sawmnih leh khat kei hon doua; himahleh, ngaiin, Mikael lal liante laka khat kei honpanpih dingin a hongpaia; huailaiah Persia kumpipa kiangah ka om nilou ta hi.
english: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; but, behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me: and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

paite: Huchiin ni nanung lam chianga na mite tunga hongtung ding bang ahia chih nang hon theisiam sak dia hong ka hi; mengmuhna lah ni tampi ading ahi lai ngala, chiin.
english: Now I have come to make you understand what shall happen to your people in the latter days; for the vision is yet for many days:

paite: Huan hiai thute banga ka kianga aman thu a gen khitin ka mai lei lam ka ngata, ka pau theikei.
english: and when he had spoken to me according to these words, I set my face toward the ground, and was mute.

paite: Huan, ngaiin, mi khat mite tapate toh kibangin ka mukte a honkhoih saka; huan ka kam kaa, thu ka gena ka maa dingpa kiangah, Aw ka TOUPA, mengmuhna jiakin ka lungkhamnate ka tungah hongkibunga, hatna ka neikei hi, ka chi a.
english: Behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said to him who stood before me, my lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows are turned on me, and I retain no strength.

paite: Bangchiin ahia hiai ka TOUPA sikhain hiai ka TOUPA toh a houlim theih ding? kei ka hihleh, keiah hatna a om kei paha, keiah leng hatna nutsiatin a om kei hi, chiin.
english: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me, neither was there breath left in me.

paite: Huailaiin mi khat mihing toh kibangin a honkhoih nawna, a honhatsakta hi.
english: Then there touched me again one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me.

paite: Huan aman, Aw nakpi taka it mipa, lau ken; na kiangah muanna om hen, hat takin om in; ahi, hat takin omin, a chi a. Huan aman ka kianga thu a gen khitin, ka hattaa; Ka TOUPAN thugen heh, ka chia a; nang lah na honhatsakta ngala, chiin.
english: He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid: peace be to you, be strong, yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak; for you have strengthened me.”

paite: Huan aman, Na kianga bang dinga hongpai ka hia na thei hia? huan tuin Persia lalpa kidoupih ding in ka kik nawn dinga; huchia ka pai khiak chiangin, ngaiin, Grik lalpa a hongpai ding.Himahleh thutak gelhnaa kigelh nang ka honhilh ding hi; huan kuamah hiaite kalha kei honlet pih a om kei uh, na lalpa Mikael chih ngallouh chiin.
english: Then he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia. When I go forth, behold, the prince of Greece shall come.

paite: Himahleh thutak gelhnaa kigelh nang ka honhilh ding hi; huan kuamah hiaite kalha kei honlet pih a om kei uh, na lalpa Mikael chih ngallouh chiin.
english: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth: and there is none who holds with me against these, but Michael your prince.”
